To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the relationship between attitudes and behavior is mediated by intentions, (2) intentions mediate the effects of subjective norm on behavior, (3) intentions are a function of attitudes and perceived behavioral control, and (4) subjective norms are a function of normative beliefs and motivation to comply.
the relationship between attitudes and behavior is moderated by the attitude object, and that this moderation is due to differences in the degree of consistency of attitudes and behavior.

(1) the personality traits of extraversion and neuroticism are related to a wide range of social behaviors, (2) the Big Five traits of openness, conscientiousness, agreeableness, and extraversion are related to the Big Two, and (3) the Big Five and Big Two are related to a broad range of behaviors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between attitudes and behavior.
the study of the relationship between attitudes and behavior, and the factors that influence this relationship.
the study of attitudes, personality and behaviour.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
attitudes, personality traits and behaviour are interrelated, and the interrelation is not always direct.
the relationship between personality and behaviour is complex, with a number of factors influencing whether or not there is a relationship between the two.
personality is an important factor in the development and maintenance of social attitudes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the theory of planned behavior is a useful tool in understanding and predicting the behavior of individuals.
the theory of planned behaviour is a good predictor of intentions and behaviours.
personality traits are related to attitudes, and attitudes are related to behavior, but the relationships between these variables is not straightforward.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the attitudes-behavior relationship is more complex than the simple attitude-behavior model.
attitudes and personality traits are not necessarily the same thing and they should be studied separately.
personality is a better predictor of behavior than attitudes are, and that the relationship between attitudes and behavior is often mediated by personality.
